structural_change: STW-S81c-TOK4-BAND 10-22 (STEWARD-S81c item, MU.BAL.SX.3): idx rg3 clock-rule successor. rg3p / rg3nqq2 hung 27-32k sinks on ONE ck over 1.04 x 1.21 mm (TT spread 223-233 ps; k-means under one port cannot fix it). The reader is cut at existing registers into 4 hard bands (R control / X response + landing + key mux / S01 / S23 engine halves), each its own small tree with registered faces, under an lp.py landed parent (D2/E1, +2 edges a crossing; cut analysis results/arch/s81_band_1022/cut_analysis.json: every seam <= 0.16 of its tracks). Flat band composition = dsdv_idx_rg3 #(IH 0, OH 1, KR 1) cycle-exact (tb lockstep); landed = flat + 2-edge landings (lp.py lockstep) with LX 8 / PD 2.
